tutorials.title: How to Fund Your Wallet via Moniepoint Bank Transfer
tutorials.summary: Step-by-step guide to transferring Naira (₦) to Moniepoint 7031537390 and uploading your receipt for automated AI inspection.
tutorials.content:
1. Open Wallet & Fund in your left navigation.
2. Copy the official Moniepoint account number: 7031537390 (Account Name: UCHECHI BLESSING OJI).
3. Complete your Naira transfer from any Nigerian bank app.
4. Take a clear screenshot of the successful receipt showing the amount, date, and beneficiary.
5. Upload the screenshot in Ultimate Tech App and click Submit Deposit.

tutorials.title: Renting Virtual SMS Numbers & Instant Refund Protection
tutorials.summary: How to choose the right country carrier, receive OTP codes within seconds, and use auto-refund if you cancel before arrival.
tutorials.content:
1. Navigate to SMS Numbers in your workspace.
2. Pick the target app (WhatsApp, Telegram, Google, OpenAI, etc.) and select your preferred country carrier.
3. Click Rent Virtual Number to activate a 15-minute dedicated session.
4. Enter the assigned number into your app and watch the live SMS inbox for your OTP code.
5. If no OTP arrives, click Cancel & Refund to return 100% of the Naira fee back to your wallet.
